Class SimulationRunner

java.lang.Object
SimulationRunner
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class SimulationRunner extends Object implements Runnable
Runs the SUMO simulation in a background thread. Executes simulation steps and provides real-time updates via concurrent maps.
Version:
2.0
Author:
M A T^2 H Team
